tasks.title: Create and Switch to Lab Model
tasks.instructions: Ensure you are using the model `mod7-cos-lab`.
hints: Run `juju switch mod7-cos-lab` or `juju add-model mod7-cos-lab` if not present.

tasks.title: Configure Subsystem Model Logging
tasks.instructions: Configure the model `logging-config` to enable detailed tracing on uniter workers and debug on units: `<root>=INFO;unit=DEBUG;juju.worker.uniter=TRACE`.

tasks.title: Deploy Workload Application
tasks.instructions: Deploy the `ubuntu` charm with application name `web-app` into `mod7-cos-lab`.

tasks.title: Deploy Grafana Agent Subordinate
tasks.instructions: Deploy the `grafana-agent` charm into the `mod7-cos-lab` model.

tasks.title: Integrate Workload with Grafana Agent
tasks.instructions: Establish a relation between `web-app` and `grafana-agent` via the `cos-agent` interface endpoint.
hints: Run `juju integrate web-app:cos-agent grafana-agent:cos-agent` or `juju integrate web-app grafana-agent`.
tasks.check: juju status --model mod7-cos-lab --format json | jq -e '.relations // {} | to_entries[] | select(.value.endpoints[]?.name == "cos-agent")' >/dev/null 2>&1
